T: On the run. Still need dinner.
D: Harry, Ron and Hermione leave Hogwarts behind to hunt down Voldemort's Horcruxes.
P: Serve the snacks when the guests arrive for Bill and Fleur's wedding at the Burrow.
S: Bill and Fleur's wedding in the marquee at the Burrow
Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and dill, and little gougères of gruyère choux, laid out on silver trays for the guests.
the late-night café where the Death Eaters find them
Thick chips cooked twice, at 140C then 190C until crisp, served in paper with salt and malt vinegar.
Bill and Fleur's Shell Cottage by the sea
Crab meat folded through mayo, lemon and chives, piled onto toasted sourdough with a pinch of paprika.
M: Whole trout cooked over the fire with lemon and herbs, with buttered potatoes. Stuff 4 cleaned trout with lemon slices, dill and butter, season and wrap in oiled foil.
Christmas Eve in snowy Godric's Hollow
Beef chuck and onion simmered 3 hours in stock and red wine, spooned into a dish under puff pastry and baked at 200C for 25 minutes.
W: Lemon sponge baked in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes, filled with lemon curd and whipped cream, dusted with icing sugar and topped with white flowers.
K: Dark chocolate melted into hot milk with a pinch of cinnamon, whisked and poured into tin mugs.

s.note: Bill and Fleur's wedding in the marquee at the Burrow
s.how: Top 16 blinis with creme fraiche, smoked salmon and dill. For gougeres, boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g flour, then 2 eggs and 75g grated gruyere. Pipe small balls and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Arrange both on silver trays.

s.note: Bill and Fleur's Shell Cottage by the sea
s.how: Fold 250g crab meat through 3 tbsp mayonnaise with lemon zest, a squeeze of juice and snipped chives. Toast slices of sourdough and cut into fingers. Pile the crab on top and finish with a pinch of smoked paprika. Serve by the sea if you can.

m.how: Stuff 4 cleaned trout with lemon slices, dill and butter, season and wrap in oiled foil. Cook on a hot barbecue or at 200C for 18 minutes. Serve with 800g boiled potatoes tossed in butter and parsley.

w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and the zest of a lemon, then fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Fill with lemon curd and whipped cream, dust with icing sugar and top with white flowers.

d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate and a pinch of cinnamon until smooth and frothy. Pour into tin mugs and wrap your hands around it while the wind shakes the tent outside.
